response.rationale: R2 is supported by the full composite: nail-matrix-based spindle proliferation with villous fibroepithelial projections and nail thickening, all characteristic of onychomatricoma. R3 shares the villous projection wording but lacks its defining distal nail bed keratotic/erythronychia presentation, and the raw findings emphasize nail matrix origin, favoring R2.

rejected.why: Overlaps on fibroepithelial villous histology but is not supported by the nail-matrix location, nail thickening, or absence of defining onychopapilloma features such as distal subungual keratosis and longitudinal erythronychia.
